description:
The linked account's current-period usage against its temporary allowance, with the 80 % warning and reset time.
Use: the user asks how much is left; after quota_exceeded or a quota warning.
Inputs: `period`: only "current" in v1.
Returns: `allowance`, `used`, `warning_80`, `reset_at`, `account_mode`, `ramp`, `days_to_sunset`.
Auth: linked.
name: get_usage
title: Get current usage and allowance
